manifest.name: Forest
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: An earthy green theme with layered gradients inspired by woodland canopies

css: :root { --bg-primary: #f0f5ec; --bg-secondary: #dce8d4; --bg-card: #fafcf8; --text-primary: #2b3a28; --text-secondary: #5a6e55; --accent: #4a8c3f; --accent-hover: #3a7030; --border-color: #b8cfb0; --shadow-color: rgba(74,140,63,0.1); } body { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f0f5ec 0%, #e4eedd 40%, #dce8d4 100%) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } .card, .card-item { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px var(--shadow-color) !important; border-radius: 8px !important; } .card-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(74,140,63,0.18) !important; } header, .header { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-secondary) 0%, #c8dabb 100%) !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } button { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } button:hover { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: #fff !important; border-color: var(--accent) !important; } .modal-content, .menu-section { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 10px !important; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) !important; } input, textarea, select { background-color: #fff !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } input:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent) !important; outline: none !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74,140,63,0.12) !important; } .tag { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #5ca04f) !important; color: #fff !important; border-radius: 10px !important; padding: 3px 10px !important; font-size: 0.85rem !important; } .breadcrumb a, a { color: var(--accent) !important; } .toast { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--shadow-color) !important; }
